dependency_graph.assessment: The graph shows no dependencies for ciso8601, consistent with the checkout (setup.py has no install_requires, no pyproject build-system table so setuptools default; test-only pytz). It lists 23 direct PyPI reverse dependents (e.g. homeassistant, tortoise-orm, influxdb-client), so a riscv64 wheel unblocks real consumers. Debian resolute already packages python3-ciso8601 2.3.3 for riscv64 so source builds work. Graph does not distinguish build/test deps; those come from the checkout. Transitive reverse dependencies were not expanded.

proposal.rationale: ciso8601 is a pure C extension (module.c, timezone.c, isocalendar.c) built with setuptools and cibuildwheel, with no third-party native libraries and no arch-specific code. PyPI 2.4.1 has no riscv64 wheel, issue #181 requests one, and its prerequisite (closeio/cibuildwheel v3.4.1+) is met since the repo uses fork v4.3.5, which has riscv64 manylinux_2_39/musllinux images. Maintainers merged native-runner arch rows (#151, #178) and now test every wheel in CI (#192). A bounded CI/config patch is feasible; risks are listed in the dossier.

path_coverage.assessment: Add matrix include os ubuntu-24.04-riscv with cibw_archs riscv64 to build_wheels (mirrors ubuntu-24.04-arm/aarch64, native-per-arch, not QEMU); add riscv64 to [tool.cibuildwheel.linux] archs for consistency (CIBW_ARCHS env overrides). Legacy cp38/pp38 step has no riscv64 identifiers but CIBW_ALLOW_EMPTY=1 is set; PyPy has none on riscv64 and is skipped.

cibuildwheel runs test-command 'python -m unittest' with pytz (pure py2.py3-none-any on PyPI) inside the riscv64 manylinux container on the native runner. The 'test' sanity job is x86_64 ubuntu-24.04 and needs no change. tox.ini listed only as inspected; expected to need no change.

release.yml calls build-wheels.yml with upload:true; artifact name uses matrix.os-cibw_archs so the new row uploads automatically; release.yml likely unchanged. PyPI upload is manual by Close staff (RELEASING.md, #97). Org must install the RISE runner GitHub App.

No build-system table; setuptools default and setup.py extension need no change. Optional classifier work unnecessary since Operating System :: OS Independent. Only cibuildwheel archs config is touched.
Add an Unreleased entry noting riscv64 wheels. README lists no architectures; CONTRIBUTING requires no CLA/DCO.

module.c, timezone.c, isocalendar.c are portable C with no arch dispatch, intrinsics or assembly (CONTRIBUTING forbids hand-written arch asm); no riscv64 source change expected, though 2.4.1 fixed an aarch64-only segfault found by per-wheel testing, so native riscv64 test results must be watched.

proposal.release_coverage: PyPI 2.4.1 (2026-11-09): macOS arm64/x86_64/universal2, manylinux1 x86_64, manylinux2014 aarch64, musllinux_1_2 x86_64/aarch64, win_amd64, win_arm64; no riscv64. RISE index has only 2.3.3 cp312-cp314 riscv64.
proposal.build_backend_and_native_dependencies: setuptools via setup.py (no build-system table), cibuildwheel (closeio fork v4.3.5, v3.4.1 for legacy 3.8); no third-party native libs.
proposal.dependency_wheel_availability: Build: setuptools 84.2.1 and wheel 0.48.0 are py3-none-any on PyPI. Test: pytz 2026.6 py2.py3-none-any on PyPI. All pure Python, so public PyPI wheels are compatible with any riscv64 interpreter/libc; the RISE index returns 404 for setuptools, wheel, pytz and build (not needed). No PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL/PIP_PREFER_BINARY required; if added anyway they would go in the cibuildwheel step env (and test step) in build-wheels.yml. uv not used.
proposal.release_graph: build-wheels.yml (pull_request to main/master, workflow_dispatch, workflow_call) -> test (py3.8-3.15, ubuntu-24.04) -> build_wheels matrix and build_sdist; release.yml (workflow_dispatch) -> sanity_check -> build-wheels.yml upload:true -> artifacts; manual PyPI upload.
proposal.architecture_precedent: Dedicated native runner rows: ubuntu-24.04-arm/aarch64, windows-11-arm/ARM64, macos rows. No shared ubuntu-latest QEMU architecture list exists, so recommend ubuntu-24.04-riscv with CIBW_ARCHS riscv64.
proposal.fork_guards: None: no github.repository conditions in the three workflows.
proposal.contribution_rules: CONTRIBUTING.md and PR template (what/why/focus/impact/testing); CHANGELOG entry; no CLA/DCO; no arch-specific assembly.
proposal.target_matrix: ubuntu-24.04-riscv, CIBW_ARCHS=riscv64, manylinux_2_39 default image, cp39-cp315 (cp315 prerelease handled by cibuildwheel); cp38 and PyPy produce no riscv64 builds. Test with python -m unittest.
